name: io.github.tonyyang0504/twitch-social-mcp
description: Twitch (social): me, publish_text, reply_comment, delete. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Twitch app client id (dev.twitch.tv console); also sent as the Client-Id header required on every Helix call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Twitch app client secret (form body of the refresh request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user:write:chat and moderator:manage:chat_messages. 'Because refresh tokens may change, your app should safely store the new refresh token': the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/twitch.json (mode 0600).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_BROADCASTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id of the channel whose chat is used (GET /helix/users?login=…).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_SENDER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id of the token's user (GET /helix/users with the token); sender of messages and moderator for delete.
